user.title: Set up TTS Relay
user.description: TTS Relay plays a satellite's voice replies and announcements to a media player. A route relays one or more satellites to one speaker. You can add routes now or later, from the integration's page.

add_route.title: Add a route

data_description.name: Name of the route, like "Living room to Sonos".
data_description.satellites: The Assist satellites whose replies to relay. A satellite can only be in one route.
data_description.target: Media player that plays the replies. Only players that support announcements are offered. For any other, add it to Music Assistant and pick the Music Assistant player.
data_description.volume: (Sonos only) Volume of the replies. Leave empty to use the speaker's set volume.
data_description.duck: Lower whatever plays on the speaker from the start of a command until you stop speaking.
data_description.announcements: Also play the satellite's announcements on the speaker. Reply rules don't apply to these.
data_description.silence: Silence reply copies sent to the satellite. LED animations keep working.
data_description.stream: With a conversation agent that streams, like most LLM ones, start playing a long reply while it's still being written, as the satellite does. **Rules that look at the response can't apply to these replies.**
data_description.rules: Rules for further altering responses. Custom rules should go into config/tts_relay/rules/

error.name_taken: Another route already has this name.

reply_format.title: {target} can't play replies from {satellite}
reply_format.description:
{satellite} asks Home Assistant for its replies as {format}. Sonos speakers only play MP3 and WAV as announcements.

This is usually seen in a Home Assistant Voice PE, which asks for FLAC. Set its firmware to ask for WAV instead, as described under "Learn more". This message goes away after the next reply from {satellite} that {target} can play.

silence_needs_ffmpeg.title: The satellites can't be silenced without ffmpeg
silence_needs_ffmpeg.description:
*Silence the satellites* is on for {routes}, but ffmpeg isn't available. TTS Relay needs it to give the satellites a silent copy of their replies, so for now they will be played out loud. Everything else keeps working.

Home Assistant normally comes with ffmpeg. If yours doesn't, install it, or set the path to it in the FFmpeg integration, and restart Home Assistant. This message goes away once ffmpeg is found, or once no route has the option on.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stops playback on media players, including announcements still playing.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reads the reply rules and sounds again, from the integration and from config/tts_relay/.
